title: The Vanishing Negatives
description: remove_negatives(numbers) returns the list without its negative numbers, keeping the order. Some negatives survive.
solution:
def remove_negatives(numbers):
    return [n for n in numbers if n >= 0]
hint: What happens to the loop's position when you remove an item from the list you're looping over?
explanation: Removing items while iterating shifts everything left, so the loop skips the element right after each removal. Two negatives in a row means the second survives. Build a new list instead of mutating the one you're iterating.
